workflow.name: FortiGate IPsec VPN Troubleshooting
workflow.description: Guided troubleshooting workflow for route-based FortiGate IPsec VPN problems.

tunnel_down.title: VPN Tunnel Down
tunnel_down.description: Use when the IPsec VPN is not established.

tunnel_up_no_traffic.title: VPN Up But No Traffic
tunnel_up_no_traffic.description: Use when the IPsec tunnel is established but application traffic is not passing.

check_vpn_status.title: Check VPN Status
check_vpn_status.purpose: Determine whether IKE Phase 1 and IPsec Phase 2 are established.

check_underlay.title: Check Internet / Underlay Reachability
check_underlay.purpose: Verify that the FortiGate can reach the remote VPN peer before debugging IKE.
commands: diagnose sniffer packet any 'host <REMOTE-PEER-IP> and (port 500 or port 4500)' 4 0 l

debug_ike.title: Debug IKE Phase 1
debug_ike.purpose: Collect IKE negotiation evidence after basic underlay checks are complete.
debug_ike.warning: Debug commands should be filtered and used for a limited troubleshooting window. Verify the IKE log-filter syntax on the exact FortiOS 7.4 maintenance release before production use.

check_phase2.title: Check Phase 2 / IPsec SA
check_phase2.purpose: Verify IPsec security associations, selectors, and tunnel state.

check_ipsec_counters.title: Check VPN Packet Counters
check_ipsec_counters.purpose: Determine whether traffic is entering and returning through the IPsec tunnel.

check_route.title: Check Routing
check_route.purpose: Verify that the destination resolves toward the intended VPN path.

routing_failure.title: Routing Failure Identified
routing_failure.purpose: The VPN is established, but FortiGate does not have the expected usable route toward the remote destination.
likely_causes: Missing route to the remote destination
Route pointing to the wrong interface
Competing route with better distance or priority
Dynamic routing has not installed the expected route
VPN interface is not being selected for the destination
recommended_checks: Check for a more preferred competing route
If dynamic routing is used, verify neighbor state and route advertisement
Confirm the route exists in the active routing table, not only in configuration

check_policy.title: Check Firewall Policy
check_policy.purpose: Verify that the VPN traffic matches the intended firewall policy.

check_nat.title: Check NAT
check_nat.purpose: Determine whether source NAT is expected and whether the correct translated source is being used.

check_session.title: Check Session
check_session.purpose: Determine whether FortiGate created a session and which policy, NAT, and forwarding path are being used.

flow_debug.title: Run Filtered Flow Debug
flow_debug.purpose: Observe FortiGate packet processing and identify routing, policy, NAT, or session decisions.
flow_debug.warning: Always use narrow source/destination filters and stop the debug after collecting sufficient evidence.
commands: diagnose debug flow show function-name enable

packet_capture.title: Capture VPN Traffic
packet_capture.purpose: Verify where traffic enters and exits the FortiGate and whether return traffic is received.
commands: diagnose sniffer packet any 'host <SOURCE-IP> and host <DESTINATION-IP>' 4 0 l
